integrity.evidence: Analytical derivations and a standalone finite reproducibility checker are supplied; checks are not infinite proofs.

scientific_limitations: The external-angle and width formulas hold for the standard Euclidean coordinate realization, not arbitrary affine images.
The aspect-ratio result gives a pointwise limit at each positive finite ratio, not a universal quantitative rate.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed; the included deterministic finite checks corroborate the analytical proof.
An equivalent result under a broader normal-fan or anti-blocking permutohedron framework remains a bibliographic possibility.
title: Gaussian normal-cone angles and a third-order width transition for partial permutohedra
